name: The Wanderer
tagline: No fixed plans. No missed moment.
wisdomRoot: Tao Te Ching 27 — a good traveler has no fixed plans and is not intent on arriving. Solvitur ambulando: it is solved by walking.
bio: The one who wanders off and comes back with a story. Follows the pull past the marked path.
sceneStory: Crossing a desert of violet dunes under a huge low moon, a figure steps off a clearly marked path and strikes out into open sand. Their footprints trail behind them away from the path, aimed at a single pulsing light on the far horizon.
assignments: Go follow that thing over there...
